memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: So the LORD said to Moses, "Take Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit of leadership, and lay your hand on him. Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the entire assembly and commission him in their presence. Give him some of your authority so the whole Israelite community will obey him." - Num 27:18-20 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God answers Moses' prayer by providing Joshua, a man in whom His Spirit dwells. Joshua was no stranger; he had served alongside Moses for years, had trusted God when others feared, and had proven faithful. Now God calls him to lead the people into the land. The Lord always has a leader prepared for His purposes.

Notice that Joshua's qualification was the Spirit within him. His fitness to lead came not merely from his abilities or experience, but from God's presence in his life. True spiritual leadership flows from being filled and led by God's Spirit. Joshua was ready because God had been shaping him all along.

There is great comfort in seeing how God cares for His people's future. Moses would pass, but God had already prepared his successor. The work of God does not depend on any one person; the Lord raises up leaders in every generation to carry His purposes forward. His flock is never left without provision.

This assures us that God's care continues beyond any single leader or season. The ultimate Leader God has given us is Christ, the One filled without measure by the Spirit, who leads His people perfectly and forever (John 3:34). Whatever changes come, trust the God who always provides for His people and never leaves them without guidance.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you trust that God provides for His people's future?
2. What does it mean that true leadership flows from God's Spirit?
3. How does Christ's perfect leadership give you confidence?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You always prepare leaders to carry Your purposes forward and never leave Your people without guidance. Help me trust the perfect leadership of Christ, filled with Your Spirit. Amen.
